name: @temples/engine
description: Declarative DOM-based HTML template engine: data-bind attributes, partial real-time updates, no framework.

scripts.build: bun build src/engine.ts --outdir dist --format esm --target browser --packages external --entry-naming "[name].[ext]" && bun build src/engine.ts --outdir dist --format esm --target browser --packages external --minify --entry-naming "[name].min.[ext]" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
